advice: The representations spec field named function holds the running total F(x), not the rate f; the renderer or author could misread it as f. Rename or document the field.
Orientation, ki-1 and ki-2 all serve the same static graph; three figures of one picture add little. The shaded orientation could be text and ki-2 carry the partition.
chk-3 options B and D share one error path and read nearly alike; one could instead carry the rate units error (gallons per hour for a total).

The lesson teaches recognition for both archetypes, the first written line (partition; units of the integrand) and the rivals, and the scoring habit through the BC-PT-99069 line and sg-23:2 interpretation requirement.
